_note: A sum qualifying under Income-tax Act, 2025 s.123 — Schedule XV para 1(w): "contribution by an employee of the Central Government to an additional account referred to in section 20(3) of the Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority Act, 2013 (23 of 2013) of the pension scheme notified by the Central Government, as referred to in section 124 (a) for a fixed period of not less than three years; and (b) which is as per the scheme as may be notified by the Central Government for the purposes of this clause" (Gazette 265620, p.563). D-130. A fixed period of not less than three years — an entry condition.
displayName: Central Government employee's additional pension account
